checks.name: Initial batch preparation publishes an owned result
Settings and categories are captured from the same catalog read
Stored queue identities and role/collision labels belong to that same cohort
Initial preparation changes no settings, jobs, catalog or command guard
Preview policy refresh observes current settings without mutating an older snapshot
Preview-only preparation skips unused category and queue work
A real writer holds Manager before the initial batch read
The initial reader returns without waiting for the catalog writer
An initial batch owner cannot start duplicate readers
Cancellation joins acquisition before the external writer releases
Another accepted command defers initial batch reading
Cancelling the initial read never clears another command's guard
Read errors are returned with their worker consumed
The same owner can retry initial preparation after a read failure
Notification failure cannot undo the published cohort
Repeated cleanup leaves no reader or accepted ownership behind
